USP 31 (Meclofenamate Sodium). A white to creamy white, odourless to almost odourless, crystalline powder. Freely soluble in water, the solution sometimes being somewhat turbid due to partial hydrolysis and absorption of carbon dioxide; the solution is clear above pH 15. Slightly soluble in chloroform; practically insoluble in ether; soluble in methyl alcohol. Store in airtight containers. Protect from light.
